name: CarExpert

source_quote: CarExpert outperforms state-of-the-art LLMs in generating natural, safe and car-specific answers.

name: DeepTest 2026 LLM Testing Competition: automotive manual assistant benchmark
domain_subtopic: testing an LLM car-manual retrieval assistant for missed safety warnings
source_quote: Four tools competed in benchmarking an LLM-based car manual information retrieval application
notes: Competition report (Sorokin, Vasilev, Pasini; DeepTest@ICSE 2026), not a corpus per se: a RAG car-manual assistant is the system under test and tools generate failure-revealing user inputs. Included as an evaluation-set lead in the CarExpert family; low priority for the list.
